relevance_note: Case series of four patients with TNFAIP3 variants described individually: "We describe four unrelated patients evaluated at a single tertiary center, each carrying a distinct TNFAIP3 mutation".
method_note: Read the whole paper by hand; values were typed into a Python builder script in the scratch directory (no table was transcribed by script; Table 1 has 4 rows, checked by eye). Labels: the paper's own labels A, B, C, D (Table 1 and text; 'Case 1-4' also used). In scope besides A-D: relatives described as affected or tested (A's paternal and maternal aunts with oral ulcers; B's father with the same variant, paternal grandfather with HA20, paternal great-grandmother with oral ulcers, the one brother with oral ulcers; C's maternal aunt who died of lupus; D's father and mother, both tested negative for the variant), and four previously published patients mentioned in the Discussion with individual-level facts (labels 'ref (15, 16) patient', 'ref (2, 12, 22) patient', 'ref (24) patient', 'ref (26) patient'). Left out: unaffected untested siblings and mothers (A's brother, B's mother and other brother, C's sisters); A's sister with neurodevelopmental delay and D's older brother with anxiety and epilepsy (untested, not described as affected by HA20-related disease; judgement call); the mother and grandmother of the ref (26) patient (only a Behcet's diagnosis given); group mentions (breast marginal zone lymphoma patients, 'a few previously identified patients are male'). D's parents tested negative: recorded in clinical_diagnosis_basis since the individuals table has no genotype field; no variant rows for them. B's paternal grandfather 'had HA20' but no variant is tied to him, so no variant row. The ref (24) patient may or may not be B's father ('as found in the father of patient B (24)'); kept separate, not merged. Variant type: only A's p.Pro247Leu is named as missense. The paper says three of four patients had nonsense variants but never names which, so variant type is 'not reported' for B, C and D (not derived from HGVS). Pathogenicity 'identified as pathogenic' comes from Discussion sentences naming each exact variant (p.Arg271*, p.Trp168*, p.Q379*); none stated for p.Pro247Leu. Normal findings (D-27): B's 'normal chest x-ray (CXR) and electrocardiogram' and D's normal sinus and pulmonary CT are whole investigations, recorded as abnormal CXR/ECG/CT excluded and nothing more specific (no ILD exclusion). Narrow vs broad: A's negative uveitis and retinal vasculitis screening does not exclude the broader checklist items 'uveitis or other ocular inflammation' and 'vasculitis' (left not reported). Lab values without a stated reference range (A's ANA 1:160, D's CRP 60.9 mg/L) were recorded as observed findings; checklist autoantibodies (A) and elevated inflammatory markers (D) marked observed from them. A's 'poor weight gain' mapped to checklist growth failure. B's 'fever with pericarditis' is not recorded as recurrent fever. is_proband left null for A-D and the literature patients (not called proband/index case; series of four); relatives false. Vital status left not reported for living patients (not explicitly stated). No stacked cells. No internal contradictions found.
